research.label: RESEARCH NOTE
research.statement: Automated systems need access to project knowledge, not just perception and task logic.
research.body: The next generation of construction automation should connect machine perception and planning with the information that actually governs a project: drawings, specifications, BIM, scope, sequence, schedule, safety constraints, RFIs, submittals, daily reports and project history.
